title: How to make a state that reduces characteristics through StateCounter?

posts.author: LolKekCh
posts.body: I want to make a state that reduces DEF by 20%*X, where X = the number of StateCounter.  I tried to do this using "YEP BaseParametreControl", but I couldn't. Anyone can help please?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body: You would need to use a plugin that allows you to change parameters dynamically, like Quasi's Params Plus or Hakuen Studio's Dynamic Parameters.
